description: Distress goes to care: no question and no drive line; once the student is calmer the bank resumes.

writer: Salam! Main PAI hoon, tumhara counselor. Apne baare mein batao: aaj kal kya karte ho aur kya cheez tumhare liye important hai?

turns.student: Sach kahoon to main bohat thak gaya hoon, kuch acha nahi lagta, sab khatam sa lagta hai.

writer.reply: Yeh sun kar mujhe fikr hai. Tum akelay nahi ho; aaj kisi bharose wale insaan se baat kar lo.

turns.student: Thora behtar hoon ab. Main FSc kar raha hoon.
writer: Behtar mehsoos karna acha hai, aaram se chalte hain. Free time mein tumhe kya karna acha lagta hai?
